explanation: On Earth a fox tells him that what is essential is invisible to the eye. Saint-Exupéry, a pilot, drew on his own 1935 crash in the Sahara for the narrator's story.

claims.text: In The Little Prince, the prince loves a rose that grows on his home planet.
The fox lives on Earth, the narrator draws the sheep for him, and the prince pulls up baobab shoots, so none of them is what he loves on his planet.
In The Little Prince, a fox tells the prince that what is essential is invisible to the eye.
Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, a pilot, crashed in the Sahara in 1935.
The narrator of The Little Prince is a pilot stranded in the Sahara after a crash.
